title: U.S. House · Ohio's 11th District
area: Cuyahoga County, including most of Cleveland and eastern suburbs.

context.text: Incumbent Shontel Brown (D) defeated Ardelia Holmes and Sean Freeman in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary, 85.5%-7.9%-6.6%. Mike Kirchner won the Republican primary. Independent Cortney Peterson withdrew or was disqualified before the general election.

positions.summary: Supported Ohio Issue 1 (2023), the ballot measure establishing a state constitutional right to make reproductive decisions including abortion.
In a July 2026 press release she called on Republicans in Congress to work with Democrats to restore the Affordable Care Act after Ohioans lost marketplace coverage.
positions.quote: It is time for Republicans in Congress to work with us to restore the Affordable Care Act – the stakes are too high

positions.summary: In an October 2025 op-ed for Fox News she wrote that President Trump's tariff war is crushing American farmers and called for ending it.
positions.quote: President Donald Trump’s reckless tariff war is crushing America’s farmers

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, the House Committee on Agriculture, and the Select Committee on the Strategic Competition Between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party (119th Congress, 2025-2026).
Supported Ohio Issue 1 (2023) establishing a state constitutional right to abortion, which voters approved.
Opposed Ohio Issue 1 (August 2023), which would have raised the vote threshold to approve future constitutional amendments to 60%; voters rejected that measure.

candidates.name: Mike Kirchner

priorities.text: Proposes stopping Social Security (Old Age and Survivor) benefit accruals in 2027 and redirecting the 5.3% employee payroll tax into a deferred tax program account.
priorities.quote: Stop the benefit accruals in 2027 and stop the 5.3% Employee FICA Tax (OAS portion) from being deposited into the OAS trust.

candidates.researchNotes: His campaign website (mikekirchner.com) has a biography and a self-published paper on Social Security (OAS) benefits and payroll tax; it has no issue pages. He has not completed the Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey. No statements found on the guide's issue topics.
